rules.statement: A co-owner who plants is not entitled to the entirety of a plantation or other improvement made by him on common land, but may be entitled to compensation for improvements.
rules.supporting_quote: "The partition Ordinance provides for a co-owner being allowed credit for any improvement made by him, but there is no law which declares a co-owner entitled to the entirety of a plantation or other improvement made by him on the common land, unless of course he has acquired it by prescription."
